8770-milton.title: Milton
8770-milton.creator: Mark Pattison, B.D.
8770-milton.description: A book by Mark Pattison, B.D.. as Toland says of him, made it his business to learn all he could about Milton's habits. Aubrey was himself acquainted with Milton, and diligently catechised thepoet's widow, his brother, and his nephew, scrupulously writing down each detail as it came to him, in the minutee of lives which he supplied to Antony Wood to be worked up in his _Athenae_ and _Fasti_.

arxiv-2103-06213.title: The norm attainment problem for functions of projections
arxiv-2103-06213.creator: Albrecht Böttcher and Ilya M. Spitkovsky
arxiv-2103-06213.description: Abstract The paper is concerned with the problem of identifying the norm attaining operators in the von Neumann algebra generated by two orthogonal projections on a Hilbert space. This algebra contains every skew projection on that Hilbert space and hence the results of the paper also describe functions of skew projections and their adjoints that attain the norm.

arxiv-2202-04709.title: Transferred Q Q -learning
arxiv-2202-04709.creator: Elynn Y. Chen, Michael I. Jordan, Sai Li
arxiv-2202-04709.description: Abstract We consider Q Q -learning with knowledge transfer, using samples from a target reinforcement learning (RL) task as well as source samples from different but related RL tasks. We propose transfer learning algorithms for both batch and online Q Q -learning with offline source studies.

arxiv-2203-17177.title: A Python Package for Sampling from Copulae: clayton
arxiv-2203-17177.creator: Alexis Boulin
arxiv-2203-17177.description: Abstract The package clayton is designed to be intuitive, user-friendly, and efficient. It offers a wide range of copula models, including Archimedean, Elliptical, and Extreme. The package is implemented in pure Python , making it easy to install and use. In addition, we provide detailed documentation and examples to help users get started quickly.

arxiv-2209-11322.title: On proving the robustness of algorithms for early fault-tolerant quantum computers
arxiv-2209-11322.creator: Rutuja Kshirsagar, Amara Katabarwa, Peter D. Johnson
arxiv-2209-11322.description: Abstract The hope of the quantum computing field is that quantum architectures are able to scale up and realize fault-tolerant quantum computing. Due to engineering challenges, such “cheap” error correction may be decades away. In the meantime, we anticipate an era of “costly” error correction, or early fault-tolerant quantum computing .

arxiv-2507-15482.title: Delayed Launch of Ultrafast Outflows in the Tidal Disruption Event AT2020afhd
arxiv-2507-15482.creator: Zikun Lin, Yanan Wang, De-Fu Bu, Junjie Mao, Jifeng Liu
arxiv-2507-15482.description: Abstract We report the detection and characterization of ultrafast outflows (UFOs) in the X-ray spectra of the tidal disruption event (TDE) AT2020afhd, based on observations from NICER , Swift , and XMM-Newton . Prominent blueshifted absorption features were detected exclusively during the intermediate phase of the event, occurring between days 172 and 212 within the first 300 days post-discovery.

arxiv-2602-04640.title: Towards Structured, State-Aware, and Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Software Engineering Agents Conference: 7th International Workshop on Bots and Agents in Software Engineering ; April 12–18, 2026; Rio de Janeiro, Brazil 7th International Workshop on Bots and Agents in Software Engineering (BoatS
arxiv-2602-04640.creator: Tse-Hsun (Peter) Chen
arxiv-2602-04640.description: Abstract . Software Engineering (SE) agents have shown promising abilities in supporting various SE tasks. Current SE agents remain fundamentally reactive, making decisions mainly based on conversation history and the most recent response. However, this reactive design provides no explicit structure or persistent state within the agent’s memory, making long-horizon reasoning challenging.

pmc-10610658.creator: Qing Liu, Jing-Wen Xie, Ming Wang, Yu-Tong Du, Zi-Ge Yin, Ning-Xin Zhou, Tong-Yan Zhao, En-Jiong Huang, Heng-Duan Zhang, Hans-Peter Fuehrer
pmc-10610658.description: Invasive alien species are a growing threat to natural systems, the economy, and human health. Active surveillance and responses that readily suppress newly established colonies are effective actions to mitigate the noxious consequences of biological invasions. Aedes (Hulecoeteomyia) koreicus (Edwards), a mosquito species native to East Asia, has spread to parts of Europe and Central Asia since 2008.

pmc-10698441.title: Biliary hemorrhage caused by a malignant small round cell tumor in the common bile duct: A case report
pmc-10698441.creator: Ying-Li Jin, Ye-Jiao Ruan, Guang-Rong Lu
pmc-10698441.description: BACKGROUNDMalignant small round cell tumor (MSRCT) metastasis to the common bile duct associated with recurrent biliary hemorrhage is extremely rare. Thus far, there have been no reports of metastatic small round cell tumors of the common bile duct.CASE SUMMARYHerein, we report the case of a 77-year-old female patient with an MSRCT in the common bile duct.

pmc-11297144.title: Operational application of Fengyun geostationary meteorological satellites to cloud observation products
pmc-11297144.creator: Mingbin Du, Shuang Luo, Jun Shi, Wei Guo, Jiating Zhang, Hao Gu, Wen Gu
pmc-11297144.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cloud products from geostationary satellites are the main alternative to surface synoptic cloud observations (SYNOP), and have become the baseline products for the development and construction of the Quality Management System (QMS) of integrated meteorological observation in China. This study addresses the needs of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA) for such an operational reform, and it is carried out using real-time observations obtained from the Fengyun-2E (FY-2E) geostationary satellite in 2012 to derive cloud total amount and classification using two different methods.

pmc-11652730.creator: Anastasiia Mykhailenko, Piotr Zieliński, Aleksandra Bednarz, Fredrik Schlyter, Martin N Andersson, Bernardo Antunes, Zbigniew Borowski, Paal Krokene, Markus Melin, Julia Morales-García, Jörg Müller, Zuzanna Nowak, Martin Schebeck, Christian Stauffer, Heli Viiri, Julia Zaborowska, Wiesław Babik, Krys
pmc-11652730.description: In many species, polymorphic genomic inversions underlie complex phenotypic polymorphisms and facilitate local adaptation in the face of gene flow. Multiple polymorphic inversions can co-occur in a genome, but the prevalence, evolutionary significance, and limits to complexity of genomic inversion landscapes remain poorly understood.

pmc-12403342.title: Efficacy and safety of cold snare polypectomy for outpatient treatment of sessile polyps smaller than 10mm
pmc-12403342.creator: Chunmei Li, Xinyu Xie, Jian Qin, Yufei Ding, Xiaojuan Ma, Shanshan Liu, Miao Chen, Dandan Dong, Jing Sun, Xuedan Deng, Lulu Liu, Hongyan Cui
pmc-12403342.description: BackgroundScreening colonoscopy plays a critical role in reducing colorectal cancer incidence by identifying and removing polyps. Simple and safe treatment is the most common request of both doctors and patients. Cold snare polypectomy (CSP) is increasingly favored for polyps < 10 mm, yet concerns remain regarding residual tissue.

pmc-12456029.creator: Song Li, Anhong Dai, Yihao Zhou, Xu Chen, Yizhou Chen, Li Zhou, Xiaolin Yang, Mengqi Yue, Jing Shi, Yong Qiu
pmc-12456029.description: BackgroundNon-invasive neuromodulation (NIN) technology, a promising approach in the field of neuromodulation, has been employed to address a diverse array of disorders, with an increasing volume of research emerging. Traditional Chinese acupuncture has also been utilized as a complementary and preventive therapy for various ailments.

pmc-12469302.title: From Desert Greening to Human Health: A Systematic Review of the Extraction, Unique Structure, and Bioactivity of Sea Buckthorn Proanthocyanidins
pmc-12469302.creator: Zixin Zhou, Zongyi He, Yu He, Qiang Peng, Antonio Cilla
pmc-12469302.description: Sea buckthorn (Hippophae rhamnoides) is an ecologically significant shrub that has been effectively employed to combat desertification. Recently, its economic potential has garnered substantial scientific interest. Sea buckthorn proanthocyanidins (SBPs), which are key antioxidant bioactive compounds found in sea buckthorn, exhibit remarkable free radical scavenging capacity and multi-target biological activities, including anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, vision protection, and cardiovascular protection effects.

pmc-13346244.title: Clinical lipidomics in bacterial sepsis: a systematic review of serum and plasma evaluations
pmc-13346244.creator: Nurul Saadah Ahmad, Rosni Ibrahim, Toh Leong Tan, Syarul Nataqain Baharum, Zamberi Sekawi
pmc-13346244.description: BackgroundLipid metabolism plays a central role in host-pathogen interactions and immune regulation during bacterial sepsis, with its dysregulation contributing to organ failure and mortality. Blood-based lipidomics has emerged as a promising approach for identifying diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in sepsis. However, discrepancies in lipid profiles between serum and plasma remain a major challenge for clinical translation.

pmc-13472167.creator: Jaideep Singh Bhalla, Ushasi Saraswati, Agam Bansal, Ossama Abou Hassan, Allan Klein, Clement Lau, Kamil Stankowski, Federico Marchini, Subhi Akleh, Deepti Ranganathan
